The logger instance for output and diagnostics.

## Signature

```typescript
protected _log: Logger;
```

## Remarks

This logger provides trace-level diagnostics for the entire package processing hierarchy, including Liquid engine creation, variable initialization, action collection setup, and build configuration preparation. It's passed down to child components (actions and build configurations) to maintain consistent logging throughout the package lifecycle.
